title: Maestría en Ciencia y Tecnología de Inteligencia Artificial y Ciencia de Datos
institution: Instituto Politécnico Nacional (IPN), Escuela Superior de Cómputo (ESCOM)
about: ESCOM-IPN's master's in science and technology of AI and data science runs its B27 admission round (August 2027 start): registration from 7 September 2026 to 16 April 2027, evaluation 19 April to 25 June 2027, online interviews 7-18 June 2027.
requirements: Minimum score of eight or equivalent in English (or another language set by the faculty)
Pass the admission exam and the interview
Register through the online form and share a folder with documents (CURP or passport for foreign applicants, CV, transcript, degree certificate, English certificate)

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: Skill "Artificial intelligence" → objective "Reinforcement learning (RL): Q-learning, policy gradients, actor-critic, RLHF"
Skill "Data science" → objective "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
Field "Artificial intelligence and data science" → objective "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
